tasks.short: Complete shift summaries and incident or accident reports.

steps.what: Capture actual shift activity, incident observations and actions without inferred causes
Transfer existing train-running identifiers and timestamps into the report draft
inputs: actual existing train-running records: service ID, vehicle ID, date, time, stop and event status

steps.what: Draft report narrative from actual operator facts and verified operational fields
outputs: draft shift summary or incident report

loop.input: actual operator facts and verified operational fields
loop.check: Check omissions, chronology, meaning and source linkage; distinguish observed facts from unknown cause
loop.stop: Missing or conflicting sources or two failed checks return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed report sections first; variable incident accounts require contextual prose

steps.what: Check complete final report, dates, facts, disclosure and exact reporting destination
inputs: draft shift summary or incident report
actual source records and disclosure requirements
outputs: checked final report and authorised internal destination

steps.what: Save final shift or incident report
inputs: checked final report and authorised internal destination

steps.what: Submit final report to the actual internal reporting recipient
inputs: checked final report and authorised internal destination

tasks.design: Use native rail-report fields first, then transfer existing train-running fields within operating/reporting systems {OPS_SYSTEM}. Ground any narrative assistance in the operator's actual account and retain complete checking before separate save and internal submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operator reports can re-key existing running data and rewrite factual accounts.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked transfer and checked narrative drafting can reduce those repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Only actual witnesses can supply observations; cause and disclosure require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator distinguishes what was actually seen from a possible explanation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing train-running fields can prefill reports where accessible, and checked prose assistance can express actual accounts.

assumptions: Provisional shares, not measured. Existing operating recorder produces service/vehicle IDs, local time with timezone, stop/event status and source timestamp; require complete matching IDs and quality before transfer. Missing/mismatched records return to manual lookup/entry; no inferred telemetry or cause.

Primary observations captured by operator in s1. Existing native prefill earns zero new saving; use it before integration. Shift/incident alternatives reweight actual route and shared facts counted once.

Internal reporting route shown; operator is not assumed to file external regulatory reports. Any actual separately assigned external submission needs its own exact-final-report gate. Save/send retained at full effort with existing final checks.
unknowns: Which running fields are actually accessible and re-keyed?
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting save time after complete factual checking?

incremental.description: Maintain source mapping, access and report-drafting quality checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final report and storage destination; edits void check
s4 exact final report, disclosure and internal recipient; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 existing-data transfer +25*0.35 narrative =28.75 gross minus1.5 upkeep; low halves eligible gross. New observations, final checking and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Greet passengers and answer fare, schedule, transfer and routing questions.

steps.what: Greet actual passengers and hear their journey questions
Retrieve and verify current fares, schedules, transfers, routings and disruption information
inputs: actual current approved fare, service and disruption records

steps.what: Choose and check the final passenger explanation against actual journey needs
Provide checked final information and answer the actual passenger question

tasks.design: Configure native current-service and fare lookup in passenger-information systems {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain greeting, understanding, final answer selection/checking and actual spoken delivery; reduce only repeated lookup.
tasks.previous_blocker: Journey questions may require navigation across current fare and service sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked current-service search can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Passenger needs and service uncertainty require contextual explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The operator adapts a route explanation to the passenger's actual needs.
tasks.altitude: Faster verified lookup during human passenger service.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native journey/fare lookup can reduce source navigation; conversation and contextual explanation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual fare/service owners provide current versioned records; operator checks currency and disruption applicability. Missing/conflicting sources require manual inquiry and explicit uncertainty.

Existing lookup earns zero new saving. Final spoken-answer check uses existing reasoning without extra approval work; changed passenger question or service state returns to s2/s3/s4. No conversation recording or invented service log.
unknowns: Which approved current-service source is accessible?
research_questions: How much actual lookup effort can native linking remove?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final explanation to actual passenger under current service conditions; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.50=10 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All passenger interaction and checking retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend driver and passenger safety meetings and learn implications.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual driver/passenger safety meeting materials and agenda
inputs: actual organiser-supplied agenda and safety materials

steps.what: Attend actual safety meetings and learn implications for job performance
outputs: actual attendance and chosen learning implications

steps.what: Capture and check any actual assigned safety-meeting notes
inputs: actual attendance and chosen learning implications

steps.what: Save checked final actual safety-meeting notes

tasks.design: Configure native meeting/material links in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. Retain attendance, understanding job implications and new assigned note capture/check before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding actual meeting material can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/material links can reduce that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Learning actual safety implications requires participation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator relates a safety discussion to actual operating practice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native meeting links can reduce preparation lookup; they do not replace attendance or learning.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual organiser produces agenda/materials; operator verifies them. Existing links earn zero new saving.

Notes only if actually assigned; omit absent branch and reweight. Attendance/understanding never inferred from invitation. Any actual enrolment or note delivery is a separate final-version action with no saving claimed.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final actual meeting notes and destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*0.40=4 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual meeting and notes/check/save retained.
